feeds.title: Gardeninacity
feeds.description: Notes from a wildlife-friendly cottage garden. Jason is a gardener, garden blogger, native plant and habitat gardening enthusiast.

feeds.title: Tangly Cottage Gardening Journal
feeds.description: From garden to garden: a photo diary from the corner of Columbia and Pacific. A gardening business with a passion for fascinating, collectible plants.

feeds.title: Holt Cottage Garden Blog
feeds.description: Holt Cottage Garden is my journey in our Southland garden. Hi, I am Faimie, a 50 something home gardener, dog lover, recycler, quilter and parent of one technically brilliant adult son Brodie and partner of Mike, the tidy gardener - I'm the untidy gardener!! My blog aims to record the garden - the successes and failures, mistakes, seasonal change and development of wildlife habitat as well as floral art created from the garden and the odd recipe or two.

feeds.title: Tangled Gardens Blog
feeds.description: My name is Susan, sole gardener and proprietor of Tangled Gardens. A collection of cottage gardens, small flower field, kitchen garden, tiny orchard and woodland gardens. All in a bit of a tangle at the best of times. With a fondness for heirloom flowers that are delicate and airy with intoxicating fragrance and a touch of wildness. It is here, tucked away in towering dahlias and piles of hydrangeas, you can find me on an endless gardening journey.

feeds.title: Pam's English Cottage Garden
feeds.description: I am Pamela T. Hubbard. A blogger, author, photographer, and master gardener. This blog is about English-style Gardening in the Poconos. I long for my Grandmother's garden in England that I remember as a child, and I am trying to create something similar in the Pocono Mountains of Pennsylvania.

feeds.title: London Cottage Garden
feeds.description: I am Julie Quinn and I hope you will enjoy this blog about creating the cottage garden style in your town garden. I aim for lots of wildlife, enjoyable gardening without any pressure, lots of greenery and movement and scent and colour. Best of all, lots of sitting in the garden enjoying an oasis in the city.

feeds.title: Cottage Grove Garden Club
feeds.description: Cottage Grove Garden Club is Connecting Gardeners Around the Grove.

feeds.title: Joanne's Cottage Garden
feeds.description: Hii! I am Joanne Moretti. I decided to write about my passion for gardening past, present, and future. I have been ill suffering from Lyme Disease since May 2003 but at last, after long term antibiotic treatment getting my life back and can again enjoy my garden.

feeds.title: Sofias Country Gardens Blog
feeds.description: Welcome to my garden blog from the south of Finland, where I grow organic vegetables and flower borders, maintain the farmland and follow nature in the country. A gardening enthusiast private organic cottage and kitchen gardens in the south of Finland. A mix of vegetables, flowers, wildlife, and natural gardening.

feeds.title: The Gardener's Cottage Blog
feeds.description: Hi, I'm Janet and I write this mediocre blog. I try to live as simply and stylishly as I can in this small cottage that was built in 1890 for the gardening staff of a large estate. I love vegan cooking, gardening and herringbone jackets. I try my best to always shop second-hand first but I also buy new.
